player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee leek {player_id} ee Connect Four.
Akïïm de yin: {symbol}.
Kööcëëk ee tööŋ ee {num_rows} ku {num_cols} ku akïïm.
Leek ayeŋ këŋ ayeŋ bëëk akïïm tööŋ ee kuat (0 ku {end_col}).
Akïïm ayeŋ tïïŋ këŋ ayeŋ bëëk akïïm tööŋ ee kuat, nhial, ku kuëëth ayeŋ yïn.
Këŋ yïn, yïn ee kuat ee akïïm tööŋ ee kuat ku bëëk yïn.
Tëëm ee kuat: '[col 4]' ku '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Aacï kɔc ye ke gɔ̈ɔ̈r ë puɔl yic tïŋ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Riŋ {player_id}, Cäth ke yäär format. Ee bëny thïn: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Riŋ {player_id}, Cäth ke yäär. Colom {col} ee lɔŋ kɛmɛ.
invalid_move.already_full: Riŋ {player_id}, Cäth ke yäär. Colom {col} ee full.

action.dropped_disk: Riŋ {player_id} acë kekë disk ({player_symbol}) thïnë colom {col}.

outcome.win: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} ee tɔŋ në mɛt de ŋuan!
outcome.draw: Ke ye këde thök ke cïn raan cë bɛ̈n riɔp.
